items.title: This Tech CEO Is Building the “Linux of AI”
items.summary:
The next big AI battle isn’t about who has the biggest model. It’s about where the AI actually runs.

@qualcomm CEO Cristiano Amon told me the future of AI is distributed — where AI runs wherever it makes the most sense.

Sometimes that’s in the cloud, on your phone, your car, your PC, your wearable, or the edge device right in front of you.

And Qualcomm is betting big on powering that entire system.

From Dragonfly C1000 for AI data centers, to High Bandwidth Compute for more efficient inference, to the Modular acquisition that Cristiano says could become “the Linux of AI,” Qualcomm is trying to make AI run across basically everything.

So the next era of AI may not be one app you open on one device.

It may be intelligence spread across the entire computing system.

#Ad #AI #futuretech #SponsoredByQualcomm

items.title: The Shocking Gap in AI Safety vs AI Development
items.summary: In episode 1007 of the SuperDataScience Podcast, Jon Krohn talks with Benjamin Todd, President of 80000 Hours about the massive disparity between AI capabilities and safety research. Todd reveals that while potentially millions work on advancing AI capabilities, only about 1,000 people globally work on AI safety research. This represents one of the most neglected yet crucial career opportunities for making a meaningful impact on humanity's future.

items.title: Why Fine-Tuned (SFT, LoRA) LLMs Lose Their Gradients
items.summary:
The reasoning process in AI models based on the transformer architecture are analyzed in detail. Researcher find, that even if during the supervised fine-tuning new data have been learned by the neural network architecture, the LLM still might fail to reason over it. 

How is this possible? 

all rights w/ authors: 
Towards Mechanistically Understanding Why
Memorized Knowledge Fails to Generalize in Large
Language Model Finetuning
Lu Dai2,1 Ziyang Rao1 Yili Wang1 Hanqing Wang1

items.title: Cactus Needle - The 26M Function Calling Model
items.summary:
